title: Cross-Team Launch Readiness Checkerboard
body:
Purpose:
This is a compact, visual 'checkerboard' tracker intended to align Product, Eng, SRE, Observability, and Customer Success on the final 6-week runway before a public launch. It blends a tactical task grid (by squad x phase) with the launch KPI watchlist and decision triggers so cross-team owners can scan readiness at a glance.

How to use this sheet (quick):
- Each cell = squad x phase tile. Use R/G/A (red/yellow/green) and short owner notes.
- KPI watchlist below: live formulas and target thresholds for go/no-go.
- Contingency triggers are explicit thresholds that automatically recommend fallback actions (manual at present).
- Update cadence: daily in the last 10 days, 3x/week in week 2–3, weekly earlier.

Checkerboard grid (example snapshot - update row/column as needed):
Columns (phases):
- Phase 0: Internal beta (slices)
- Phase 1: Closed preview (10 customers)
- Phase 2: Ramp (50–500 customers)
- Phase 3: Public launch
- Phase X: Post-launch stabilization (0–14 days)

Rows (squads / owners):
- Product (Aisha P.)
- Serving Runtime (Marcus C.)
- Observability & Console (Sofia M.)
- SRE / Infra (Ravi K.)
- Customer Success & Onboarding (Elena G.)

Example cells (current statuses):
- Product / Phase 0: GREEN — feature gating complete; acceptance tests pass (owner: Aisha). blockers: none.
- Serving Runtime / Phase 1: YELLOW — batching config validated but edge-case OOM on long-history prompts. owner: Marcus. blocker: small quantization discrepancy; mitigations: restrict max-history for preview customers.
- Observability / Phase 2: YELLOW — tracing hooks integrated; dashboard panels missing token-level cost breakdown. owner: Sofia. blocker: missing sample queries for 3rd party enterprise telemetry.
- SRE / Phase 3: RED — autoscale policy not exercised with load generator >3k rps. owner: Ravi. blocker: load generator cluster quota; immediate action: provision burst nodes (temp).
- CS / Phase X: GREEN — onboarding docs drafted and playbooks attached. owner: Elena. blocker: none.

KPI Watchlist (single row summary for executive scan):
- KPI: P95 request latency (text-gen, 1024 tokens) | Target: <150ms | Current: 172ms | Status: YELLOW | Owner: Marcus | Required action: micro-batching tweaks + kernel selection (see PO-421).
- KPI: Token cost per 1k (hosted) | Target: <$0.60 | Current: $0.48 | Status: GREEN | Owner: Finance-sync (J. Lee) | Note: trending up when quantization not applied.
- KPI: Error rate (5xx) | Target: <0.5% | Current: 0.9% | Status: RED | Owner: SRE | Action: hotfix rollout and rollback toggle prepared.
- KPI: New user activation (first-week usage) | Target: 45% | Current: 31% | Status: YELLOW | Owner: CS/Product | Action: tweak onboarding prompts; measure A/B.
- KPI: Canary fidelity (semantic drift score) | Target: <0.03 per eval | Current: 0.02 | Status: GREEN | Owner: Applied ML | Notes: include 10 additional edge cases next run.

Decision triggers (explicit go/no-go thresholds):
- Blocker (NO-GO): Any production-class 5xx spike >1% sustained for 30min during ramp.
- Performance (MUST MITIGATE): P95 latency >200ms at target concurrency for >15min -> restrict preview traffic and reduce model family / fall back to lighter quantized variant.
- Cost (CONSIDER): Token cost spike >20% vs forecast for 48h -> pause non-essential background caching fills and engage Optimize team to tune batching.
- Quality (MUST MITIGATE): Canary regression >0.05 semantic drift -> rollback model version and run re-eval.

Capacity ramp plan (concise):
- Week -6 to -3: baseline reserved slots for preview (20 GPUs total, mixed A100/RTX)
- Week -2: add burst pool (autoscale from 20 -> 60 GPUs) and validate autoscaler with synthetic load (owner: Ravi).
- Week -1: dry-run at 70% expected peak for 2h x 3 days (owner: Release Eng).
- Launch day: pre-provision 1.2x expected steady-state for first 6 hours.
- Post-launch: scale down to steady-state + 10% buffer after 24h if error and latency thresholds stable.
Cost snippet (estimate):
- Baseline reserved month: $X (internal spreadsheet); burst cost per day estimated via cloud quoting tool. See linked GH script: github:infra/repo#234 for estimator.

Contingency playbook (if a trigger fires):
- Assign a dedicated Incident Lead (IL) and Runbook Lead (RL) from SRE; declare incident severity and notify on #launch-ops.
- Immediate short-term mitigations (15–60 min window): divert traffic to lower-cost region, enable model-fallback, enable rate-limiter on non-critical routes.
- Medium-term (60–240 min): rollback problematic rollout, scale up burst pool, escalate to Exec if SLAs at risk.
- Communication: CS to draft initial customer-facing note within 30min; Product to post internal summary and affected customers list.

Runway sprint lanes (last 10 days example):
- Day -10: lock behavior surface (feature flag matrix) — owners: Product / Eng
- Day -8: complete canary tests & tracing validation — owners: Observability / SRE
- Day -6: CS walkthroughs with pilot customers — owner: CS
- Day -4: capacity dry-run at 70% — owner: Release Eng / SRE
- Day -2: final compliance checklist and audit logs verified — owner: Security & Compliance
- Day 0: launch window & communications — owner: PM + Exec comms

Acceptance checklist (go criteria):
- All Phase 1 customers onboarded and stable for 72h -> checkbox
- No open P0/P1 bugs blocking core flows -> checkbox
- KPI watchlist: all MUST MITIGATE items resolved or have documented mitigations -> checkbox
- Rollback plan & toggles verified -> checkbox
- Observability: full per-route tracing and token cost lineage enabled -> checkbox

Open questions (working):
- Do we allow preview customers to opt into the long-history feature if they accept higher latency/cost? (Product decision)
- Which customer segments qualify for graduated ramp vs. instant public access? (CS/RevOps)
- Are there legal review items for EU region that require an extra lead time? (Legal)

Next actions (this doc owner):
- 2024-11-05: provoke a 3h load test to validate autoscaling (owner: Ravi).
- 2024-11-06: shipping of kernel fallback patch to staging; PR: github:infra/repo#245 (owner: Marcus).
- 2024-11-07: run onboarding script with 5 pilot customers and collect activation metrics (owner: Elena).

Notes & context links:
- See linked PRD (confluence:PRD-9876) for feature surface and restrictions.
- Related JIRA (POPS-421) contains the acceptance tests and the known OOM reproduction steps.
- Use this sheet as the single source for cross-team daily standups in the final week.

Doc history:
- created by Aisha Patel 2024-10-15
- 2024-10-28: added capacity ramp plan (Ravi K.)
- 2024-11-04: inserted KPI watchlist snapshot and decision triggers (Marcus C.)

(End of snapshot)
